# Iranian Enterprise AI Bridge (IEAB)
> Open-Source Production-Grade Node.js/TypeScript Platform for ERP/CRM/BPMS -> AI Executive Intelligence

## Overview
The Iranian Enterprise AI Bridge (IEAB) provides a governed, secure, and evidence-first architecture connecting Iranian enterprise software (System Group/Rahkaran, Chargoon/Didgah, Shomaran/ShAuto, Rayvarz, Sepidar, PayamGostar, Odoo, SQL Server) to modern AI systems without numerical hallucinations or direct risky LLM SQL generation.

## Core Architectural Principle
Deterministic calculation engines calculate authoritative financial and operational metrics governed by CFOs and COOs. The LLM acts as an intent parser, orchestrator, and natural-language synthesizer that strictly cites deterministic evidence, reconciliation badges, and source record references.

## Key Modules
- **Canonical Model (`@ieab/canonical-model`):** Vendor-independent domain models across 11 enterprise domains with immutable lineage.
- **Semantic Layer (`@ieab/semantic`):** CFO-governed metric definitions and KPI contracts.
- **Metrics Engine (`@ieab/metrics`):** Deterministic KPI calculator, anomaly detector, cash runway forecaster, and subledger-to-GL reconciliation engine.
- **Security & RBAC (`@ieab/policy-engine`):** Read-only query enforcement, PII masking for Iranian National ID / IBAN, and role-based policies.
- **Connectors (`connectors/*`):** Standard connectors for Generic MSSQL, Rahkaran, Chargoon, ShAuto, Sepidar, PayamGostar, Odoo, and Excel/CSV drop.
- **Executive Copilot (`@ieab/agent-runtime`):** Evidence-first conversational engine with 100 Strategic CEO Questions benchmark.
